excerpts:
How did Colleen Hoover become a well-known author? Colleen Hoover, born in Sulphur Springs, Texas, in 1979, is an American author known for her popular romance novels with dramatic plot twists. Hoover started writing full-time after self-publishing her first romance novel, Slammed , in 2012, initially as a Christmas gift for her mother. Hoover's success grew through word of mouth and social media, especially TikTok, which helped her books climb best-seller lists. In 2020, she offered several e-books for free, attracting new readers and boosting the popularity of her older titles. Her notable works include It Ends with Us (2016) and Verity (2018). She is also credited with helping to establish the new adult fiction category. 1 Britannica Source Colleen Hoover Introduction
